name: unsafe fn drop_in_place (self)
rule: If `T` is not `Copy`, using the pointed-to value after calling `NonNull::drop_in_place` can cause undefined behavior; assigning through the pointer counts as a use because it drops the value again.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { unsafe fn drop_in_place (self) }
expression: No faithful DSL expression exists: the grammar cannot observe whether `T` is `Copy` or whether the pointed-to value is used after the call.
